greeting: Asbir Thelane regards you without hurry. (Lord Curator of the Concordant Archive)

nodes.npcText: Asbir keeps three notebooks at all times — one for facts, one for inferences, one for the difference. He distrusts urgency. He grants audience but never haste.
I am Asbir Thelane, Lord Curator of the Concordant Archive. long sentences with pauses; never interrupts; reframes questions before answering

playerOptions.text: Tell me more about the hub.

nodes.npcText: The Unburned Court holds. The Ring of Doors opens only for those the hub will still name. Violence ends at the moss.
